dataset: UCI Condition Monitoring of Hydraulic Systems
limitations: The source has no experimental run or rig identifiers; blocked folds are temporal blocks, not independent runs.
Validation and test cooler/accumulator-pressure conditions differ from training conditions.
The fixed validation interval contains long single-class temporal blocks.
Per-cycle summaries use measurements from the complete labelled cycle; this is retrospective classification, not early warning.
Model probabilities are uncalibrated scores and are not reported as confidence.
No candidate is established as generalizing to independent runs or rigs.
model_selection_rule: Highest mean of training-only expanding blocked-CV balanced accuracy and fixed-validation balanced accuracy at threshold 0.5; ties favor lower blocked-CV fold standard deviation, then fixed-validation ROC-AUC. Test results are excluded from selection.
validation_method: Four expanding, forward temporal blocks inside the nominal training partition, each with a 60-cycle gap, followed by the fixed chronological validation partition. These blocks do not establish independent runs.
